assessment: The strongest resolved calls are the precise May core-PCE range and taper-before-hikes sequence, plus the three-year energy allocation. The policy interpretation contains a substantive error: flexible inflation averaging did not obligate the Fed to compensate the prior decade, and the earlier target was already symmetric. Separate those institutional inaccuracies from the successful near-term policy patience forecast. Long-decade forecasts remain open; causal oil and speculation arguments are less well identified.
